items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Bix Beiderbecke worked on the band, Jimmy McPartland and them people.

ctx.x: the Capitol, the Admiral... Oh, through the years they must have had like fifteen or twenty boats. Their boats plied the Ohio River, the Missouri River out of Kansas City, and the Arkansas River -- all the rivers in the Basin, the Mississippi Basin.
And they had these bands, big...these coaster bands. Bix Beiderbecke worked on the band, Jimmy McPartland and them people.
